paragraphs: Chattermill’s mission to turn every customer interaction into actionable insight mirrors my recent work on NLP pipelines that surface hidden sentiment from unstructured data.
I built NLP and agentic RAG workflows with Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain and LangGraph, delivering end‑to‑end retrieval‑augmented generation for real‑time feedback analysis.
I developed an XGBoost churn classifier in R using tidymodels, a two‑stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE within the recipe and MCC evaluation, achieving robust predictive performance.
